## Files included in SWS

All SVG files are in `sws-editor/public/images/electrical/`.
They are served at runtime under `/images/electrical/<filename>.svg`.

The full symbol set was downloaded: electrical/analog/digital circuit
symbols conforming to ANSI and IEC standards.

## Modifications

None. Files are used as-is.

## Attribution requirement (CC0)

CC0 waives all copyright and places the work in the public domain.
No attribution is legally required, but the source is documented here
for provenance and reproducibility.

## Note

The repository also includes a README and Inkscape-specific library file
(`.xml`). Only the `.svg` symbol files are included in SWS.
